changelog: Initial release: 25-criteria evaluation framework (ISO 25010, OpenSSF, Shneiderman, agent-specific heuristics). Automated structural checks + manual rubric. Eval template included.
summary: Evaluate Clawdbot skills for quality, reliability, and publish-readiness using a multi-framework rubric (ISO 25010, OpenSSF, Shneiderman, agent-specific heuristics). Use when asked to review, audit, evaluate, score, or assess a skill before publishing, or when checking skill quality. Runs automated structural checks and guides manual assessment across 25 criteria.
